limitations: Current-member universe omits delisted stocks; current adjusted price vintage is not point-in-time data.
Previously inspected history is reused exploratory research, not an untouched holdout.
Six-output MLP is shared-hidden multi-output learning, not transformer multi-head attention.
Fit uses earlier 504 sessions; the following 252 calibrate weights; outcomes crossing boundaries are purged.
Annual model refits do not imply annual holdings: daily signals hold 1, 3 or 5 sessions after next-close fills.
Training-only median imputation can make unavailable longer-lookback features usable without future screening.
Per-date training samples bound computation; all eligible stocks receive test forecasts, irrespective of later label availability.
Pooled calibration MSE and derived weights are predictive diagnostics, not independent samples or statistical significance.
Equal-weight fallback when calibration finds no positive improvement is an explicit research control, not qualification.
Downside predictions measure completed-close path declines, not intraday losses or a guaranteed stop.
Model candidates require predicted return minus modeled round-trip cost minus half predicted downside above zero.
All accounts share whole-share cash/settlement constraints, five slots and 20% entry caps; nominal prices and synthetic adjusted marks remain exploratory.
The diversified ensemble rejects positive 60-session return correlation above .85 or pairs with fewer than 40 usable observations.
Fold boundaries flatten positions; settled/unsettled cash carries forward. Required missing prices or signal inputs invalidate accounts.
20/40/100 bps are proportional sensitivity scenarios, excluding fixed broker charges, FX, subscription, taxes, interest and contributions.
No hourly, event/news, fundamental, options, live-account or profitability qualification is claimed. No automatic paper promotion.
